pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Cool-season:$() sow as soon as the ground thaws. Sprouts after 80 °C·d above 5 °C.$(li)Ripens after $(thing)1200 °C·d$(). Best near 22 °C; stops above 33 °C.$(li)$(thing)Frost$() kills it below -6 °C (-2 °C in flower).

$(li)$(thing)Soil pH$() 6-8 (tolerates 5.5-8.5). Roots 0.7 m. Dislikes waterlogging.$(li)$(thing)Feeds on$() N 100, P 12, K 50 kg/ha per crop; fixes about 70% of its own nitrogen.$(li)$(thing)Yield$() when well grown: about 1338 lb/ac (1.5 t/ha).$(li)$(thing)Harvest:$() Lentils.
